tools.name: search_rentals_sample
tools.description: Live US rental listings for an area and budget, no key needed. Returns at most 10 listings per call (rent, beds, baths, size, address, coordinates, photo, source link, days listed). Use a state code and a city for one market; add rent and bedroom limits to narrow it. For complete results a HousingFe

tools.name: rent_summary
tools.description: What rent costs right now in one US city or ZIP, no key needed: number of listings and the median, 25th and 75th percentile monthly asking rent, overall and by bedroom count (studio, 1, 2, 3, 4+). Based on listings verified at the source in the last 30 days. Give a state and a city or a ZIP.

tools.name: feed_status
tools.description: Requires a HousingFeed key. The current version of your licensed feed: listing count, when it was published, when the next weekly update is due, and how many listings were added, changed and removed.

tools.name: search_my_feed
tools.description: Requires a HousingFeed key. Search the listings in your licensed feed by city, ZIP, rent, bedrooms or map box. Returns up to 50 per call with a total; page with offset.

tools.name: feed_changes
tools.description: Requires a HousingFeed key. Listings added, changed or removed in the latest weekly update of your feed.
